## What is coding

Text data such as interview transcrips and research papers consist of a bunch of statements. Coding is a process of assigning themes to parts of these texts to be able to make sense of them and summarize them into a manageable representation. Consider the following part of interview transcript, with the relevant parts that I have highlighted.
